question: Should the existing Browser CLI `--fields-file` path adopt a hard 1 MiB maximum, or should the ceiling be aligned with another established request-size contract?
rationale: The patch intentionally converts an unlimited existing input path into a fixed compatibility boundary, and repository evidence does not establish 1 MiB as an existing public contract.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Keep the focused implementation and merge after live CLI proof confirms the accepted and rejected paths.

options.title: Align with an existing limit
options.body: Replace 1 MiB with a documented Browser request or CLI body-size ceiling and cover that contract in tests.

options.title: Keep the path unlimited
options.body: Decline the hard limit if large local field payloads must remain supported and pursue another memory-safety design.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Keep the focused implementation and merge after live CLI proof confirms the accepted and rejected paths.
